why: The creator played the composed island levels, 2026-10-14: "We were supposed to collect berries, but there were no berries anywhere. I think in the ocean I saw some boxes". Once the berries stood on reachable ground (stream reach) the slot they are drawn with still held the kit's stand-in crate (CC0, standin-bake): the thing the player is told to collect did not look like it, and every gate passed. The class: an objective, pickup or goal drawn by a stand-in. Here the pickup's prop slot holds the kit's stand-in crate (crate.glb, the kit's own CC0 file); gate F must fail it on measure 14 and name the slot.
